11. Design patterns: Singleton,
Factory, Strategy, Observer,
Adapter, Repository

SIMPLE ENGLISH
Patterns are named reusable design approaches: one managed instance, object creation,
interchangeable algorithms, notifications, interface translation and persistence abstraction
respectively.

Q: Are patterns ready-made code libraries?
A: No. They describe a design idea; implementation varies by language and constraints.
